title: GPOM Second Half A: The Kill Bots
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half A: the kill bots
about: Cut 3 of the GPOM second half, split in two (Kai, round 2 Q5). Built by scripts/gpom/second-half-video/cut3.py A (round 3, 23 Oct 2026: Kai's round-2 notes on top of round 1's notes + picks); notes and plan in cut-notes.json, shots in ../second-half-cut3-shots.md, music in ../songs/second-half-scene-a-music.md.

beats.name: Maddie on the high street
beats.blurb: One unbroken travelling shot: the camera backs up the ruined high street and Maddie rolls after it, her radio playing the tune for about 5 s before she notices us. "Oh, hello!" Then the radio goes down, and back up on "Mind how you go".

beats.name: Kill bots everywhere
beats.blurb: The roundabout; then a kill bot under the church tower at the far end of Maddie's street; then two come out from under the rail arch.

beats.name: Patrol, low and huge
beats.blurb: A kill bot rolls over the lens.

beats.name: Their eyes: the kill-bot HUD
beats.blurb: The kill bot's own view keeps moving down the street; the HUD (patrol, teal). The meter starts to twitch as the row reaches it through the earth.

beats.name: Organic signal: lock
beats.blurb: ORGANIC SIGNAL - LOCK, silently (the pings are gone). The view keeps rolling while it listens.

beats.name: The lavatory
beats.blurb: Hard cut to full volume: Sandra, lip-synced.

beats.name: The row, up close
beats.blurb: Derek, Sandra, Derek, Sandra: shot by shot, lip-synced; we hold on Derek after "But the world ended, Sandra!"

beats.name: KILL MODE ENGAGED
beats.blurb: The same HUD on the racing view: patrol, then it flips red. The muffled row keeps the meter moving.

beats.name: One kill bot tears past Maddie
beats.blurb: High over the street: the tank passes close and exits bottom-left, Maddie jolts, a plume of dust hangs.

beats.name: Maddie in the dust
beats.blurb: Inside the dust it left: almost nothing visible, then it settles fast and Maddie is there, still.

beats.name: The far race
beats.blurb: From the footbridge: the pack races away down the motorway.

beats.name: Maddie calls her boss
beats.blurb: Maddie's hatch, the boss-hotline antenna. The call; the race (still far) under his first and last lines.

beats.name: The close race
beats.blurb: Low in the grass: the pack converges on the bunker door. Maddie over it.

beats.name: The stand-down
beats.blurb: On board one kill bot: red KILL MODE racing at the door, it brakes and flips to green STAND DOWN. Lined up at the door, they file away one at a time. Then Maddie, shaky with relief: "Good job." "That was close."
